prior: Y085 acquired four different legitimate public affine observations yet still chose matched_sham for all 384 heldout cases; mismatch reduction 30.14% violated churn/search and group non-regression gates. Underlying eligible action set has three frozen retention policies. Test strict cost-constrained development policy learning instead of another unconstrained error-first criterion.
hypothesis: Can development-time exact optimization of up to four public-key retention choices under strict group safety and churn/search budgets produce distinct actions and >10% fewer heldout mismatch episodes than quorum2 without added task-memory capacity?
freeze: Exactly 81 possible four-key maps, entries based solely on early-public a%16 in {3,7,11,15}; each action one of matched_sham/full/quorum2. Fit on development seeds 18816..18823 with constraints per pair/onset group no error regression and global churn <=1.05 baseline and calls <=1.10 baseline; shortlist eight lowest error/cost feasible maps plus quorum2 and choose on independent validation seeds18848..18855 under same safety constraints; if none feasible use quorum2. Freeze before new heldout18880..18895. Underlying Y085 public acquisition, four affine families, seven active/<=9 retained, ten public scalar reads, decoder, three matching actions unchanged.
primary: SAFE_CONDITIONAL_RETENTION_GAIN iff at least two distinct public-selected actions on heldout, >=10% fewer total mismatches than quorum2, global churn <=5% higher, matching calls <=10% higher, no individual pair/onset mismatch regression, zero steady-null and illegal assignments. CONSTRAINED_RETENTION_POLICY_COLLAPSED when chosen map exercises fewer than 2 policies. PARTIAL_CONDITIONAL_RETENTION_COST when diverse and >=5% gain but safety fails; NO_CONSTRAINED_RETENTION_GAIN otherwise. CONSTRAINED_RETENTION_STEADY_FAILURE overrides. Preserve all 384 original trial cases and 1152 policy-arm results.
controls: Developer training/validation truth only in optimization, never candidate inference; candidate reads only public a%16
Exhaustive finite 3^4=81 mapping search, bounded four-entry table, unchanged seven-active/<=nine-retained task memory
No extra public reads or hidden pair/onset inputs; same fixed public ten readings and decoder
Original frozen execution exactly once with artifact upload before post-run checks, one full pytest and independent archive-only audit
No FORGE R32/R33, accepted refs, controller/queue, production or merge
claim_limit: Finite development-only public-key rule selection under strict budget, not neural/plastic memory or RSI.
